The '''Heavy Battle Droid''' was a variant of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] which was more heavily armored than the base model. They were armed with larger and more powerful [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] than the regular B1's [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]], and wore larger "backpacks". It was used by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] during the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Heavy Battle Droid appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.
